title: Towel Bar 18-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Matte Gray | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Keep a bath towel within reach and off the counter with a wall-mounted towel bar designed for everyday use in Matte Gray, which provides a sophisticated neutral that complements concrete, stone, and other modern materials. The Carolina Collection brings traditional bathroom hardware styling with clean, refined details for a coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Maintain a clean, finished look: concealed screw mounting hardware minimizes visible fasteners
- Save space in smaller baths: wall mount design keeps floor and vanity areas clear
- Coordinate your décor: part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina and classic bath accessories
- Built for lasting performance: crafted from solid brass construction

Specs & Installation:
- Length: 18 Inch
- Overall width: 20
- Depth (projection): 2
- Height: 3.5
- Weight: 2.4 lbs
- Mounting: wall mounted; mounting hardware included; concealed screw mounting
multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
